description: Source code implementing cryptographic signing and hashing functionalities, including classes for different hash types, HMAC support, and external C interface functions for creating, destroying, ingesting data, and calculating hashes.

classes.name: SigningType
classes.description: Template class implementing signing functionality for different hash algorithms, supporting data ingestion and digest calculation.

methods.name: signing_create_hash
methods.description: Factory function to create a hash signing implementation based on specified hash type.

methods.name: signing_create_hmac
methods.description: Factory function to create an HMAC signing implementation with a secret identified by secret_id.

methods.name: signing_destroy
methods.description: Function to delete and clean up a signing implementation instance.

methods.name: signing_ingest
methods.description: Function to feed data into the signing implementation.

methods.name: signing_calculate
methods.description: Function to compute and retrieve the hash digest.
